title: Airspace Monitoring Case of a Refinery in Brazil
title_en: Airspace Monitoring Case of a Refinery in Brazil
description:
2025 Airspace Monitoring Case of a Refinery in Brazil
Equipment Used:
Stationary Spectrum Detection Equipment
Airspace Situational Awareness Platform
Command and Control Platform Software
Project Introduction:
In 2025, this refinery project deployed a low-altitude monitoring workflow for key production and perimeter areas. Stationary spectrum detection equipment collects radio-frequency activity, while the situational awareness platform organizes airspace tracks, alert records, operator notes, and review status in one interface. The command platform supports authorized teams with event logging, cross-department notification, and documented escalation procedures. Public documentation focuses on monitoring, evidence records, and compliance response workflows rather than sensitive technical response methods.
